QuestInfo.name: [Special] Fight for Azwan
QuestInfo.0:
The time has come to liberate the underground city of Azwan in the Nihal Desert. The devious commander Hila has stolen the souls of every citizen in the name of the Black Mage, and it's time for you to get them back! 

- #eRecommended Level#n: Lv. 40 and up
- #eTime Limit#n: 20 min
- #eParty Size#n: 1+
- #eRoute#n: Select <Fight for Azwan> from the Dimensional Mirror
- #eSpecial Reward#n:
